title: DeriOne
tagline: An on-chain crypto options aggregator that gives traders and developers the cheapest options price.
description: It is difficult to find the best options across protocols for developers and traders. Some people do this manually but it consumes too much time and they don't understand how each interface works. We aggregate options protocols and provide a simple smart contract method and interface for our users.
how_its_made: Each option protocol has a different interface, mechanism, and pricing formula. We wrote a simple contract that everybody can call without consuming any gas. The contract is designed in a way that a caller doesn't have to worry much about the inner working of it. They just need to call a single function. Our frontend directly communicates with this contract with the easy-to-use UI.
